question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.

gold.sql: SELECT camera_location, ROUND(AVG(head_count), 2) AS avg_crowd FROM events WHERE event_type='crowd' AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY camera_location ORDER BY avg_crowd DESC

metadata.tests: areas with most activity -> GROUP BY camera_location restricted to crowd, ranked DESC by AVG head_count
